notes:
Product/engineering-led evaluation. Primary ask: IDE copilot (VSCode plugin) with ultra-low token streaming latency and deterministic model pinning across environments. Repo-aware context: must ingest mono-repo (120GB code, ~1.2M files) -> embeddings + vector DB for retrieval. Customer insists embeddings and vector DB indices remain inside their VPC/on-premise. Quote from CTO: "We cannot allow enrichment in public cloud outside our region — residency and auditability are hard requirements." Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and Redwood Private for air-gapped option. Cost sensitivity moderate; willingness to pay more for low tail-latency and SLAs. Technical preference: small to medium code-specialized embeddings (fast perf) + option to swap embedding models; model pinning for release gating.
Shorthand: POC scope narrow: (1) index 200k recent files (2) integrate VSCode plugin streaming tokens w/ <100ms p50 token latency (3) compare retrieval recall vs Sourcegraph baseline. Security begun: SSO + SAML ok, CISO asked for SOC2 II evidence and KMS integration. SE asked for sample deployment manifest and hardware sizing.

requirements_summary: Workload: IDE copilot (streaming completion), repo-aware RAG for code context, embeddings + vector DB
Latency targets: p50 token latency <80ms, p95 <250ms for completions; initial throughput 3k rps during peak dev hours
Model concerns: ability to pin model/version per route or per-team; rollback and canary; support for faster smaller code embeddings with option to upgrade
Chunking: need function-level and file-level chunking experiments; prefer semantic chunking (AST-aware) for recall
Residency: embeddings and index must be stored inside customer VPC or on-prem; no third-party managed vector store outside region
Security: SSO/SAML, KMS key management, audit logs, retention controls (90/365 day options)
poc_scope: Index 200k files from mono-repo: validate chunking and recall vs baseline
Deploy VSCode plugin prototype to 10 internal devs; measure streaming latencies and perceived UX
Compare two embedding models (fast-code-small, code-semantic-ld) for recall/latency tradeoff
Validate vector DB connector running in their VPC (no external egress)
decision_criteria: Retrieval recall >= Sourcegraph baseline on top-3 hits for function-level queries
Sustained p50 token latency <80ms in their VPC test
Clear plan and timeline for SOC2 evidence and KMS integration
Cost per dev per month within forecasted ARR range or justify via efficiency gains
